Situation.Name: Containment at Machine Speed
Situation.Setting: A large industrial cyberpunk wind-tunnel laboratory. A transparent horizontal test chamber dominates the scene. Inside it, autumn leaves mix with luminous fragments of source code and race through a violent artificial wind. Several glowing cyan containment gates progressively narrow and organize the torrent. On the far side of the gates, the flow becomes sparse, coherent, and geometrically ordered. The woman stands outside the tunnel at a substantial physical control console, clearly operating the system rather than being trapped inside it.
Situation.Camera: Wide cinematic banner composition, three-quarter view across the wind tunnel, character shown from mid-thigh up with the full transformation visible behind and beside her

CharacterPose.Expression: Focused and steady, eyes tracking the tunnel output with quiet authority
CharacterPose.BodyPosition: Firm stance beside the control console, shoulders square, body unaffected by most of the turbulence
CharacterPose.Gesture: One hand makes a precise adjustment on a heavy control lever while the other rests near a bank of physical switches

Article.Name: Containment gates

Article.Application: Spaced through the middle of the tunnel
Article.SymbolicMeaning: Intent, tools, evidence, and validation designed into the harness

Article.Name: Coherent output stream

Environment.Name: Physical control console
Environment.Description: A robust brushed-metal console with tactile levers, switches, modest status lights, and no illegible screen text

Environment.Name: Industrial wind-tunnel chamber
Environment.Description: Thick glass, reinforced steel ribs, ducts, fans, and sensor arrays; engineered equipment rather than a magical vortex

KeyDetails: The woman is outside and in command of the tunnel, never being blown around inside it
The chaotic input and coherent output must both be visible in the same frame
Containment gates organize and reduce the torrent rather than acting as simple barriers
Leaves remain recognizable and connect directly to the originating article
The tunnel should feel like serious engineering equipment with weight, wear, and physical controls
No readable code, labels, logos, captions, or text anywhere in the image
Situation.LightingFocus: Cyan and magenta light pulses through the chaotic tunnel while warm amber console light illuminates her hands and face; a silver rim light defines her hair against the machinery
